stories.h: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT s free and Go tiers in India
stories.s: OpenAI has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India, a huge chunk of whom are on the free or the lower-priced Go tiers.
b: techcrunch.com: OpenAI to start showing ads on ChatGPT s free and Go tiers in India

body: techcrunch.com: OpenAI has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India, a huge chunk of whom are on the free or the lower-priced Go tiers.

techmeme.com: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch : OpenAI launches ads on its ChatGPT Free and Go subscription tiers in India, where it has 100M+ weekly active users, and plans to launch an ad manager next month It seems there is no escaping the ad industry. OpenAI said on Thursday that it will start showing ads on its ChatGPT Free and Go subscription tiers in India.
